rows: What is the most durable element of urban form?
Street network (persists for centuries; plot pattern next; buildings most volatile)
What block size supports walkable urbanism?
200-300ft (Portland model) vs. typical US 400-600ft
What density is required for walkability?
~20 DU/acre minimum for neighborhood retail viability
How do you measure street connectivity?
Intersection density (intersections/sq mile) and % four-way intersections
What does Space Syntax predict?
Pedestrian movement potential from network geometry; correlates with retail viability and crime
How does Paris achieve high density without towers?
Consistent perimeter block typology, 5-8 storeys, full lot coverage at street level
What is missing middle housing?
2-8 unit buildings (duplex, triplex, courtyard apt) -- the typological gap between SF houses and large apartment buildings
What is the primary cause of urban heat island?
Dark impervious surfaces + loss of evapotranspiration + canyon effect
Most effective UHI mitigation?
Urban tree canopy (shade + evapotranspiration + neighborhood scale)
What does FAR not tell you?
Building height, density (units per acre), or architectural quality
